contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 17. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right; large eye. Obverse inscription: [--]ONSTANTI [---]VS AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE ]DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue:…
